name: EPIC 228795694

text.card: A red giant 2,956 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.09 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,760 K at its surface.
